findings.evidence: Coherence.lean:118-119 claims `R² = d σ²` so "this is `exp (-Q² R² / d)`"; the only lemma with `R²` in it is MultivariateExtensions.lean:77 `integral_norm_sq_map_smul_stdGaussian`, which is never combined with the decay bound anywhere in the PR. Roadmap Photoproduction/README.md:356-362 asks for the virtuality/energy bounds "in terms of the radius".
findings.fix: Add the radius form, e.g. `‖charFun ((stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))).map (σ • ·)) q.spatialPart‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (-(∫ r, ‖r‖ ^ 2 ∂((stdGaussian _).map (σ • ·))) * -⟪q, q⟫ₘ / d)` for `d ≠ 0`, derived from the σ-form through `ProbabilityTheory.integral_norm_sq_map_smul_stdGaussian`; likewise for `one_sub_norm_charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian_spatialPart_sub_le`.
findings.issue: `norm_sq_charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian_spatialPart_le` is stated only in the width `σ`, yet the module docstring (lines 43-44) and this docstring (lines 118-119) advertise the headline product `‖F(q)‖² ≤ exp (-Q² R² / d)` in the rms radius `R`. No lemma states it; a consumer must redo `σ² = R²/d` plumbing (with `d ≠ 0`) each time. The general-measure companion `one_sub_norm_charFun_spatialPart_sub_le` (line 94) does use `∫ r, ‖r‖² ∂μ`, so the two halves of the file speak different languages.

findings.evidence: MultivariateExtensions.lean:46-49 (no attribute) against :61-63 (`@[simp]`); Mathlib Probability/Distributions/Gaussian/Multivariate.lean:75 `@[simp] integral_id_stdGaussian` and :112 `@[simp] integral_strongDual_stdGaussian` mark exactly this class of lemma.
findings.fix: Mark `integral_inner_sq_stdGaussian` `@[simp]`; the LHS is a valid higher-order pattern (`v` does not depend on the bound variable) and cannot loop.
findings.issue: `integral_inner_sq_stdGaussian` carries no `@[simp]`, while the sibling it feeds, `integral_norm_sq_stdGaussian` (line 61), does. Both are side-condition-free closed-form evaluations of an integral against a fixed measure, so the asymmetry leaves `∫ x, ⟪x, v⟫ ^ 2 ∂(stdGaussian E)` unreduced by `simp`.

summary: The surface is minimal and free of compatibility artifacts, but the Gaussian decay bound is never exposed in terms of the root-mean-square radius that the roadmap target and the module docstrings advertise, and one of the two parallel second-moment lemmas is missing the `@[simp]` its sibling carries.
